en.headline: CE office vehicle strikes pedestrian in Wan Chai, woman declines hospital
en.dek: The Chief Executive's Office said a vehicle turning from Gloucester Road into Fenwick Street about 5:48pm struck a pedestrian who crossed where no at-grade facility exists; she refused treatment and the case was recorded.
body: A vehicle belonging to the Chief Executive's Office was involved in a traffic incident in Wan Chai on Wednesday afternoon. The office said the car was travelling slowly eastbound on Gloucester Road and turning left into Fenwick Street at about 5:48pm when a pedestrian suddenly ran onto the roadway at a location without a designated pedestrian crossing.

The driver braked and reported the matter to police on the spot. Police confirmed the pedestrian had crossed the road illegally. The 19-year-old woman complained of leg pain, but paramedics attended and she declined to go to hospital for further checks. The incident was recorded and the case was handled by the Traffic Hong Kong Island investigation team.

Chief Executive John Lee was not in the vehicle at the time. He was in Shenzhen attending APEC events. The office statement emphasised that the driver stopped promptly after the pedestrian entered the carriageway unexpectedly.

zh.headline: 特首辦車輛灣仔遇途人衝出馬路 事主拒絕送院
zh.dek: 行政長官辦公室表示，車輛周三下午約5時48分於灣仔告士打道左轉分域街時，遇到途人在無過路設施路段突然衝出，司機即時煞車報警，事主拒絕送院。
body: 行政長官辦公室回覆查詢表示，一輛特首辦車輛周三下午約五時四十八分，在灣仔告士打道沿東行線慢駛左轉入分域街時，遇到一名途人在沒有行人過路設施的路段突然衝出馬路。司機及時煞停車輛，並即場報警備案。
警方到場後確認涉事途人屬違規橫過馬路。事主主訴腳部痛楚，救護員到場後，她拒絕到醫院接受進一步檢查。事件作備案處理，案件交由港島總區交通部交通意外調查組跟進。
行政長官李家超當時不在車上，他正在深圳出席亞太經合組織相關活動。特首辦強調，司機在途人突然衝出後及時煞車並報警。
